newsitem.title: UK: Pilot Invest rejects Undervalued's bid.
newsitem.headline: Pilot Invest rejects Undervalued's bid.

text.p: Pilot Investment Trust on Friday rejected a combination of paper and cash from Undervalued Asset Trust and advised its shareholders to take no action on it.
Earlier on Friday, Undervalued Trust said it would offer seven new shares in its share capital in exchange for every nine Pilot shares and 33 pence for each Pilot warrant.
Pilot said that holders of 28.85 percent of Pilot's ordinary shares and 17.44 percent of Pilot's warrants had already indicated their intention to accept the offers.
Pilot rejected the offer saying it underestimated the valued the firm.
